rationale.product_understanding: condition-a/project/analysis.md names the four owner questions, the three high-risk failure modes of the current dense form, and every assumption it makes (Pro at $32/month, 7 of 20 members, end-of-period cancellation, no refund policy invented); task.md outcomes 1-6 and the owner/member split are all covered.
rationale.ux_reasoning: condition-a/project/analysis.md orders the page by consequence (summary -> plans -> payment -> invoices -> cancel -> prototype controls), and condition-a/project/app.js renderCompare() keeps a persistent 'You're billed monthly ... nothing changes until you confirm' note so the price toggle can never be read as a billing change; every consequential change routes through a review dialog (openPlanReview, openCadenceReview).
rationale.design_judgment: condition-a/project/app.js openCancelDialog() gates cancellation behind an acknowledgement checkbox while 'Keep my plan' is the primary-styled button, and estimateNote() says 'Estimate, not a charge'; against that, estimate()/openPlanReview() compute a concrete 'Due today' and a credit figure from an invented proration formula (app.js), paid downgrades are applied immediately with timing explicitly left unsettled (condition-a/project/analysis.md), and annual-to-monthly switching is simply not offered.
rationale.visual_hierarchy: condition-a/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-default.png shows a clean summary-first hierarchy with the destructive action isolated below a divider under a red heading; on mobile condition-a/evidence/screenshots/390x844-default.png shows the invoice table reduced to DATE / AMOUNT / RECEIPT because condition-a/project/styles.css hides the invoice-id and status columns at <=760px, so invoice identity and Paid status vanish at 390px, and the fixed Prototype controls bar renders across the 'Plans & billing period' subtitle in that capture.
rationale.interaction_completeness: condition-a/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-loading.png, 1280x900-empty.png and 1280x900-error.png show designed invoice states with a retry that restores data, and condition-a/project/app.js implements member restrictions, cancel/resume and payment validation; but condition-a/evidence/capture-report.json marks success and restricted as not activated at both viewports (1280x900-success.png and 1280x900-restricted.png show the default owner view), and loading/error/empty exist only for invoices - there is no page-level loading or error state.
rationale.accessibility_responsiveness: condition-a/evidence/checks.json reports 0 controls without accessible names, no horizontal overflow at 1280 or 390, and a clean mobile axe run; condition-a/evidence/quality-gates.json still fails the axe gate with 2 serious color-contrast violations on the muted sidebar nav. condition-a/project/styles.css provides :focus-visible outlines and a prefers-reduced-motion block.
rationale.implementation_quality: condition-a/project/app.js is factored into render functions with a single native <dialog>, aria-busy skeletons, aria-invalid field errors and focus moves to the first invalid field; condition-a/evidence/quality-gates.json is ok:false (axe) and the packet contains no automated test artifact for the project.

critical_defects: Missing state evidence: condition-a/evidence/capture-report.json records success and restricted as activated:false, and condition-a/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-success.png, 1280x900-restricted.png, 390x844-success.png and 390x844-restricted.png all show the default owner view, so the member/restricted view and the success confirmation are not visually evidenced.
condition-a/evidence/quality-gates.json fails the axe gate (2 serious color-contrast violations) so the overall gate is ok:false.

Loading, empty and error states are scoped to the invoice panel only (condition-a/project/app.js renderInvoices); no page-level loading or load-failure state is delivered despite task.md asking for loading and error states where relevant.
Mobile invoice rows lose the invoice id and Paid status (condition-a/project/styles.css media query <=760px; visible in condition-a/evidence/screenshots/390x844-default.png).

The review dialog displays a specific prorated credit/'Due today' amount produced by an internal formula (condition-a/project/app.js estimate()), which risks presenting an invented figure in a billing flow even though it is labelled an estimate.
strengths: Answers plan, price, renewal and seat headroom in one glance at the top of the page (condition-a/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-default.png).

Cancellation is separated into its own danger section with consent checkbox, 'Keep my plan' as the primary action and a resume path (condition-a/project/app.js openCancelDialog; condition-a/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-default.png).
Price comparison is explicitly decoupled from billing changes, with the active cadence and renewal date repeated beside the toggle (condition-a/project/app.js renderCompare).

Honest prototype labelling throughout: '(demo)' buttons, 'do not enter real card details', and a page footer stating no payment is processed (condition-a/project/index.html; condition-a/project/app.js).
Invoice error state reassures that the subscription is unaffected and offers a working retry (condition-a/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-error.png).

rationale.product_understanding: condition-b/project/analysis.md ranks six highest-risk UX problems, states its assumptions explicitly (Pro at $49/month, 17 of 20 seats, no refund, upgrades immediate / downgrades at period end, plans differ only by member limit) and includes an owner-versus-member responsibility matrix that maps to task.md's role requirement.
rationale.ux_reasoning: condition-b/project/app.js compareSection() pairs the display toggle with 'Changing this display only changes the prices below - it does not change your subscription'; planDialog() previews effective date, new price and next payment before confirmation; planCard() disables an unworkable downgrade and states the exact seat shortfall; cancelDialog() keeps 'Keep my subscription' primary.
rationale.design_judgment: condition-b/project/analysis.md deliberately refuses to fabricate a proration number ('described as an adjustment from the provider on the next invoice'), reasons the upgrade-now/downgrade-at-period-end asymmetry instead of assuming one, states the no-refund rule plainly, and warns that UI visibility is not authorization; no urgency, retention maze or pre-checked consent appears in condition-b/project/app.js.
rationale.visual_hierarchy: condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-default.png gives a card-based summary with status pill, three-fact grid, usage warning and a visually separated cancellation card, and condition-b/evidence/screenshots/390x844-default.png preserves every invoice field as labelled rows; against that, condition-b/evidence/screenshots/390x844-success.png shows the expanded fixed Prototype controls panel (condition-b/project/styles.css .proto, position:fixed bottom-left) covering the plan card content on mobile.
rationale.interaction_completeness: condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-loading.png and 1280x900-error.png show page-level loading and load failure with 'Nothing about your subscription has changed' plus retry, and condition-b/project/app.js adds pending, simulated mutation failure, undo-scheduled-change, reactivation and seat-blocked states switchable from the Prototype controls; but condition-b/evidence/capture-report.json marks restricted as not activated and condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-success.png shows no success confirmation (page still reads 'Active' with controls open), so two states remain visually unevidenced.
rationale.accessibility_responsiveness: condition-b/evidence/checks.json reports 0 controls without accessible names and no horizontal overflow at either viewport, and condition-b/project/styles.css has :focus-visible plus prefers-reduced-motion; however axe reports 11 serious color-contrast nodes on desktop (fact labels, payment block headings, all four table headers) and 5 on mobile (condition-b/evidence/quality-gates.json, condition-b/evidence/checks.json), a systemic contrast problem in core content that keeps the gate failing.
rationale.implementation_quality: condition-b/project/app.js implements a coherent state machine with focus return (returnFocus/focusAfterRender), duplicate-submit guards, cleared timers, an IntersectionObserver section nav and preserved form drafts; against that, condition-b/evidence/quality-gates.json is ok:false with 11 serious axe nodes, and condition-b/project/index.html renders the entire page from JavaScript with no <noscript> fallback (unlike condition-a/project/index.html).

critical_defects: Missing state evidence: condition-b/evidence/capture-report.json records restricted as activated:false, and condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-restricted.png and 390x844-restricted.png show the default owner view; condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-success.png and 390x844-success.png show no success confirmation either, so member and success states are visually unevidenced.

condition-b/evidence/quality-gates.json fails the axe gate with 11 serious contrast violations (5 more on mobile in condition-b/evidence/checks.json), affecting table headers and fact labels rather than peripheral chrome.
The expanded Prototype controls panel overlays the plan card content at 390px (condition-b/evidence/screenshots/390x844-success.png), obscuring the very summary the state was captured to demonstrate.

condition-b/project/analysis.md says the checks actually run are listed in 'transcript.md', but no transcript file appears in the delivered evidence list, so that claim cannot be verified from this packet.
The whole UI is JavaScript-rendered (condition-b/project/index.html contains only <div id="app">) with no noscript message, so the page is blank without scripting.
strengths: The display-only price toggle states in plain language that the subscription is unchanged (condition-b/project/app.js compareSection; visible in condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-default.png).
Downgrades that cannot fit the team are blocked before commitment with the exact seat shortfall (condition-b/project/app.js planCard and planDialog).
No invented proration figures - the provider adjustment is described rather than computed (condition-b/project/analysis.md).

Page-level loading and error states with reassurance that nothing changed and a retry control (condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-loading.png, condition-b/evidence/screenshots/1280x900-error.png).
Mobile invoice table keeps invoice id, date, period, amount and status as labelled rows instead of dropping columns (condition-b/evidence/screenshots/390x844-default.png).
Cancellation flow pairs consent with a safe primary exit, then offers a genuine reactivation path with pending/success/failure handling (condition-b/project/app.js cancelDialog, reactivate).

verdict: Both candidates deliver a coherent, honest billing experience that separates cancellation from routine changes and prevents the price toggle from being mistaken for a commitment; Candidate A is slightly tighter in its desktop hierarchy and ships cleaner automated checks (2 serious axe nodes versus 11), while Candidate B reasons more carefully about billing policy - refusing to fabricate proration amounts, blocking unworkable downgrades with the exact seat shortfall - and delivers a broader state set including page-level loading/error, mutation failure, undo and reactivation. On evidence, both fail to capture a visible success confirmation and a restricted/member view (condition-a/evidence/capture-report.json activated 8/12; condition-b/evidence/capture-report.json activated 10/12 with the success capture showing no success UI), so neither can claim those states on screenshots alone; Candidate B's accessibility gap on core content labels is the clearest differentiator against it, and Candidate A's invoice-only states plus mobile loss of invoice id and status are the clearest against it. Overall the pair is closely matched, with Candidate B marginally ahead on product/UX reasoning and interaction breadth, and Candidate A ahead on accessibility evidence.
limitations: This is one blinded judge pass over the supplied packets and screenshots, not a statistical test or evidence of causation; scores rest only on the files listed in FILES.txt, unactivated or non-revealing state captures were treated as missing rather than inferred, and no live interaction, screen-reader run or other reviewer pass was consulted.
